ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The top row in the image is labeled mRNA, and the codons shown from left to right are AUG CCA CUA GCA CGU; the corresponding protein boxes below it are labeled in sequence Met, Pro, Leu, Ala, Arg. The question asks for the DNA strand serving as the template, not the DNA coding strand. mRNA is complementary and antiparallel to the DNA template strand: A pairs with T, U pairs with A, G pairs with C, and C pairs with G. Therefore, mRNA 5′-AUGCCACUAGCACGU-3′ corresponds to the DNA template strand 3′-TACGGTGATCGTGCA-5′.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the top row labeled mRNA shows the codons AUG CCA CUA GCA CGU above protein boxes labeled Met, Pro, Leu, Ala, Arg. Then use the question text to identify that the requested strand is the DNA template, not the coding strand. Convert the mRNA bases to the complementary DNA template bases in the opposite orientation: AUG CCA CUA GCA CGU pairs with TAC GGT GAT CGT GCA. Write the result antiparallel to the mRNA as 3′-TACGGTGATCGTGCA-5′.
